regions.title: Keep the same actual probability input and deterministic flow
regions.prose: Use the literal rate-one exponential product P, harmonic flow about c=y−η∇V(xRef), residual rate and integrated hazard. The full sealed statement also retains the actual reflection, stopped recurrence and physical-phase conventions.

regions.title: Consume the actual phase and its defect bound
regions.prose: The already verified actual smalltime theorem supplies one jointly Borel Z and every covered/fallback/common-AE/init/defect/tail property. Retain them all. Existing hazard, harmonic-flow and exponential-product producers supply continuity, initial values and probability normalization internally; none is a new public premise.

regions.title: Prove bounded test measurability and integrability
regions.prose: Restrict joint Z to each deterministic tuple and time. Continuous f is Borel, so f(Z_t) is measurable. Its absolute value is bounded by the same constant M on the entire sample space. Because P is a probability, that constant is integrable, yielding actual L1 integrability for every finite time.

regions.title: Localize the test discrepancy to the measurable defect
regions.prose: On D_t use the triangle inequality and the two global test bounds to get2M. Outside D_t the actual phase equals the free-flow phase, so their test values agree exactly. The constant indicator is integrable on P. This argument holds for each raw sample and allows ineffective jumps or later returns.

regions.title: Integrate and apply the actual first-event probability bound
regions.prose: Bound the norm of the integral by the integral of2M times the defect indicator. Both test integrals exist, so subtraction commutes with integration; probability normalization integrates the constant free-flow value. The indicator integral is2M P(D_t). Multiplication by2M≥0 preserves the already proved actual defect bound.

regions.title: Use deterministic test-flow and hazard continuity
regions.prose: Return all finite-time measurable/integrable estimates. Restrict the actual joint flow and hazard continuity to the fixed tuple. Since Φ0z0=z0 and f is continuous, f(Φ_tz0) tends f(z0). The integrated hazard is continuous at0.

regions.title: Make the quantitative error vanish
regions.prose: Continuity of the exponential and Λ0=0 give q_t=1−exp(−Λ_t)→0. Multiplication by the fixed finite constant2M preserves this zero limit. No source energy cap, moment bound or almost-sure convergence is needed.

regions.title: Squeeze the expectation difference and recover the initial value
regions.prose: The absolute expectation difference is between0 and the vanishing quantitative bound. Hence the signed difference tends0. Add the independently proved deterministic test-flow limit; subtraction cancels to give the actual clock expectation limit at0. This closes only the pointwise expectation ingredient before the source outer-state L2 argument.

mathematical_sequence: Actual definitions/producers -> measurable bounded L1 test -> pointwise2M defect indicator -> normalized integral and probability comparison -> deterministic f(Phi_t) limit/hazard continuity -> vanishing q_t and2M scaling -> absolute squeeze/signed difference/add.
